info.description:
Scores mobile money Transactions for risk and explains why. Advisory only: it raises Alerts for people to review and never blocks a Transaction.

People call with a Keycloak access token (`Authorization: Bearer ...`); services with a scoped API key (`X-API-Key: ...`). Health and readiness are open.
info.title: Transaction risk scoring

post.description:
Move a Case: open to investigating, investigating to closed_fraud or
closed_legitimate. The assigned Analyst or a Supervisor. A closed Case never reopens.
Closing as fraud stores a Fraud label for each of the Case's Transactions and queues a
`fraud.discovered` event for each, dated at the closing time (the simulation clock).
Audited.

post.description:
Score a Transaction and store it with its Risk assessment; a High Risk band raises
an Alert. Idempotent on `transaction_id`: a repeat returns the stored assessment, marked
with the `Idempotent-Replayed: true` header, and raises no second Alert.
Needs the `score:write` scope.
